catholic-encyclopedia-1913-adelophagi: A 1913 entry on the Adelophagi — the secret eaters, an obscure early sect. John Joseph A'Becket notes the scanty record. Their rites are lost to history. A name in the catalogues of heresy. Little more can be said. Epiphanius alone preserves their memory.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-alogi: A 1913 entry on the Alogi — the heretics who rejected John's Gospel. Francis Havey tells their strange denial. They feared the Montanists' misuse. The Church kept the beloved disciple. A second-century error, long dead. Their name means the wordless ones.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-antoine-pagi: A 1913 entry on Antoine Pagi — the Franciscan corrector of Baronius. Michael Ott honors his chronology. His Critica set the Annals right. The friars prized his learning. A friar among the chronologists. His dates corrected the papal lists. His Baronius fills the monastic shelves.
